key_points: Q3 revenue met estimates ($1.12B, +6.4% YoY) but Q4 guidance ($1.16B) came in 3.5% below consensus
Landmark $11.6B, 7-year Anthropic deal anchors >$14B in multi-year cloud infrastructure commitments through 2028
New AI product launches (Akamai Inference, Agent Sandbox) with expanded NVIDIA partnership signal strategic pivot
$2.2B convertible debt offering announced to fund cloud expansion and repay existing debt
Long-term revenue guidance provided through 2028; multiple analyses suggest stock 23-46% undervalued
